Definition: from G994; a halloo, i.e. call (for aid, etc.):--cry.
BiblicalUsage: A cry is the word for a call for aid, and it appears once, in the cry of the unpaid labourers. In James 5:4 the hire of the labourers who reaped your fields, kept back by fraud, crieth, and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth. One word, for wages that cry to heaven.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cry of unpaid wages still reaches the ears of the Lord of sabaoth, and the rich who keep them back will answer for it.
